question: Should this exact-head, test-only Slack flake repair be merged after its clean merge result is refreshed against current `main`?
rationale: The supplied proof is sufficient and no patch defect is established, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit maintainer merge decision and the branch is behind current `main`.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Rebase or refresh the clean merge result, rerun the Slack proof if the affected helper changes, then merge the focused test-stability fix.

options.title: Pause for Slack-owner review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a separate review of the global retained-client mock pattern before adopting it.
